placements.why: The content performs an API contract design — async dispatch, receipt, cursor polling, no-blocking, no-lost-work — which is architectural in nature and names an organizational category nothing existing holds.
placements.title: architectural design decisions as a distinct organizational tier
placements.frame: what architectural patterns and contract designs shape the system's structure?

placements.title: blocking calls give way to dispatch-receipt-cursor-poll watching
placements.frame: what design guarantees that the caller never blocks, the extraction is always watched, and no work is lost when the receipt is dropped?
placements.why: All three segments perform the async remember contract's design rules as a coherent architectural theme: remember dispatches and returns a receipt in seconds, extraction is watched by polling a cursor, no blocking call, no lost work if the receipt is dropped, and the agent either polls or gets the reaction piggybacked. This names a subject future envelopes will keep feeding — the immediate-return async contract pattern.
